{{Quote|The members of the Order have just voted to ''revoke'' the Circle of Elder's [sic] authority... and named ''me'' as All-High Priestess!|Domina Tagge|<ref name="MSW36" />}}
'''All-High Priestess''' was the title [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] created for herself when she usurped control of the [[High Circle of Elders]] with the help of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Mind trick/Legends|Force persuasion]].
